 Captains: Rhys Mariu ( New Zealand ), Dhruv Jurel ( India )
 Toss result:  New Zealand A have won the toss and have opted to field.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement New Zealand A vs. India A: Score & Updates
 Welcome to CricketNews.com's live coverage of the unofficial Test between New Zealand A and India A at Lincoln.
 India batting updates 
 KL Rahul fell for an 8-ball duck, offering an edge in the third over. 
 Yashasvi Jaiswal was also dismissed cheaply for 17 off 45 balls, caught behind off the moving new ball.
 Sai Sudharsan also departed for a 13-ball duck as India A were reduced to a precarious 44/3. 
 Dhruv Jurel, Devdutt Padikkal, & Washington Sundar were also quick to depart, and India were 58/6 at one stage. 
 Yash Rathod launched an aggressive counter-offensive against Fraser Sheat and Simon Keene. He finished as the top-scorer with a blistering 44 off 49 balls.
 Kiwi pacer Simon Keene bowled with immaculate seam presentation, tearing through the middle order with figures of 5/24 to break the spine of India A's batting.
